besluite.fout: 'Vir B3' is a compressed, English-sounding opener for a purpose.
besluite.rede: 'Om B3 te vind' states the purpose in natural Afrikaans and adds no fact.

besluite.fout: 'hulle' stands right after 'die letter en die syfer' and can be read as pointing to them instead of the photo and map.
besluite.rede: Naming the photo and the map and putting the condition first removes the ambiguous pronoun without changing the instruction.

besluite.fout: 'so' used as a conjunction meaning 'therefore' with main-clause order is an anglicism.
besluite.rede: 'en daarom' with inversion is standard Afrikaans and keeps the same conclusion.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: 'Die kolomme het ...' and 'die rye het ...' are two full clauses, so AWS 2017 requires the comma.
